outcome.technical: No executor brief existed for this start (drive-phase.py brief exited 2: .claude/state/briefs/P10.10-6rm/20261031T004719Z.executor.md missing), so I worked from the manifest task and its tests.add, as the caller instructed. TDD: drafted the tests first and saw them fail on the current code (prescan-node-backend 4 failing, prescan-core 2, merge 7, pipeline 3, agents 1, skill 1). Probing showed generics and cross-file sub-apps already parsed, so nb12 was given a chained composition case (new Hono<Env>().get().post(), app.get().post()), which failed before the fix. Changes: scripts/prescan.mjs drops EXTRACT_BUDGET, TRIM_WEIGHT and ROW_CAP. extracts/<area>.json is now the full record: every table field, `lines` on tables, the queue's declaration file and line, import ceiling 20000. It also writes extracts/<area>.summary.json (SUMMARY_BUDGET 4200: area header, `extract` path, note, `counts` per kind, the first rows of each kind, trimmed by weight with tables first), and areas[] carries `summary`. A plug-in may define `scans(inventory)`, which runs it without naming a stack. node-backend.mjs: `scans` is true for any repo with .ts/.js code. Hono chains are followed after router calls and after `new Hono<...>()` (ctorParen skips type arguments). MAX_ITEMS goes 300 -> 20000 and MAX_NESTED 100 -> 2000 (ceilings, not budgets). python.mjs: MAX_ITEMS 300 -> 20000. merge.mjs: new generateFromExtracts runs before deriveLayer. It makes one entity per declared table with declared fields and evidence at the file and lines. An explorer entity with the same table or model name is merged into it (explorer id, desc and extra fields kept). The store is chosen in order: the store that owns the file, a store that covers it, the store of an entity in the same file, the area's only store, else a generated <area>-db store. It also makes one queue node per name (<name>-queue, or an existing explorer queue node of that name) with async queue edges from each producer's and consumer's owning node. Link-derived queue edges now go to the queue node, consumer edges get their own desc, the derivation row counts what was made, and the CLI skips *.summary.json in --extracts. In update mode only affected areas' slices are generated from. pipeline.mjs: the brief names the summary path, not the full extract, and says entities, relations and queue edges come from the script and never to list tables. The entity contract line is shorter, and a last trim step cuts the floor names to 160 chars (the count stays). agents/archmap-explorer.md and SKILL.md (327 lines, line 3 byte-identical to HEAD, checked with diff) say to read the summary and never transcribe tables. Tests updated or added: nb1, nb6, nb10, nb11, nb12, nb13, pc9 (agent file + SUMMARY < 12 K), pc11, py7, py10, m13, m13c, m14 (queue node in between), m21, m21b, m21c, m21d, p1, p19, p20, a7, a8, s14. a7's ban was narrowed from /transcrib/ to /transcribe (it|the extract)\b|do not re-derive the rest/ because a8 requires 'never transcribe tables'. Fixture: tests/fixtures/repos/node-api/src/hono/reviews.ts and server.ts (synthetic, staged with git add) plus a README row. Runs: node --test from the project root exit 0, 373 tests, 373 pass, 0 fail. node --test tests/denylist.test.mjs exit 0 (2/2). docs/design.md not touched. Left for follow-up, outside this task's files: skills/architecture-map/references/model-schema.md line 108 still says merge derives 'a queue producer to its consumer' edge, and references/discovery-generic.md lines 5 and 9 still point the explorer at extracts/<area>.json and `truncated`. ts-frontend.mjs keeps its 300-per-kind cap (not in files).
